Press release by the PMO reads: "Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi chaired the third high-level meeting with Secretaries to the Government of India at his residence at 7, Lok Kalyan Marg earlier today. He discussed the future action agenda of Ministries and Departments dealing with Infrastructure and Connectivity, Security and External Affairs, and Governance. Noting that deliberations had already been held with two groups of Secretaries, Prime Minister said that Secretaries, in addition to thinking about immediate issues and statistics, should also think with a long-term perspective on how the country’s future should be shaped. Discussing the challenge of overcoming silos, Prime Minister stressed that silos are not merely an organisational problem but also a problem of mindset. He said silos can be both horizontal and vertical. He stressed that officials must take ownership of their responsibilities and work with a spirit of belongingness. Emphasising the importance of collective effort, Prime Minister cited the experience of the COVID-19 pandemic and the West Asia crisis, when officials across departments worked together effectively. He said that such coordination mechanisms should become a natural part of the government’s work culture. Prime Minister called for effective use of Artificial Intelligence while ensuring human intervention and judgement. He called for exploring innovative ways of combining the capabilities of AI with human expertise. Prime Minister emphasised that data is a national asset and a resource for the future. He noted that the government invests resources in collecting, storing and managing data, but its full potential is not always realised because of departmental silos and fragmented systems. He pointed to differences in the manner in which data is collected and managed for various purposes, and called for finding solutions that enable greater interoperability and effective use of data. Prime Minister called for greater engagement between government departments, universities and young people to bring fresh perspectives in policymaking. He said wider engagement with universities and young people can bring new and unconventional ideas. Prime Minister also called for greater focus on research and innovation, including in the defence sector. He emphasised the need to further strengthen India’s defence industry and make it more competitive at the global level. He stressed the importance of developing innovative defence courses and strengthening human resource development in the defence sector. Prime Minister also discussed the need for a comprehensive approach to strengthening India’s maritime sector. He recalled that shipbuilding was accorded infrastructure status and called for assessing whether the intended objectives are being achieved in mission mode. He reiterated the need for India to move from port development to port-led development. Prime Minister emphasised the need for better connectivity between manufacturing units and export-oriented units, so that India’s manufacturing and export capabilities can fully benefit from its maritime infrastructure. Prime Minister concluded by reiterating the need for a whole-of-government approach, greater coordination, innovative thinking and collective ownership to address complex challenges and shape India’s future with a long-term perspective. Prime Minister underlined the importance of informal interaction and building team spirit among officers. He encouraged senior officers to develop greater personal and informal engagement with junior colleagues and to build stronger networks across cadres and departments. The Secretaries shared their experiences on sectoral priorities, emerging challenges and implementation issues. The meeting was attended by the Cabinet Secretary, Secretaries of key Ministries and Departments, and senior officials from the Prime Minister’s Office." READ: pib.gov.in/PressReleaseDetai…

Grok Bot never sleeps! Elon just highlighted the real difference with Grok Bot. It runs on its own remote computer managed by SpaceXAI. Close your laptop, reboot your desktop, go to sleep, whatever. The Bot keeps working. That is the core advantage over most other agent setups right now. Self-hosted options like Hermes or OpenClaw need a machine that stays on. If that machine is your laptop, the agent stops when you close the lid. If it is a VPS you manage, you are still responsible for uptime, updates, and security. Grok Bot removes that entire layer. SpaceXAI provisions and runs the computer. One computer per account, shared across all your Bots. Browser sessions, files, and logins stay live. One Bot can pick up exactly where another left off without re-authenticating or moving files around. You can also record a workflow once (up to ten minutes) and turn it into a reusable skill. Lowest friction path I have seen for teaching an agent a multi-step process. The practical result is simple: you can hand off real work and walk away. Sales follow-ups, bug reproduction, invoice processing, research that needs to run overnight. The Bot does not need your local machine to stay alive. That is the difference Elon is pointing at. The IAEA has been informed that the 330 kV Ferosplavna-1 power line at the Zaporizhzhya NPP – the plant’s only remaining off-site power line - was disconnected at 00:44 local time today resulting in a new loss of off-site power. The location of the damage to the line was preliminarily assessed to be on the northern bank of the Dnipro River. An attempt to reconnect the line manually was unsuccessful and, due to ongoing military activity, technicians are currently unable to determine the cause of the outage. Emergency diesel generators automatically started up to power the plants vital safety systems. The IAEA team at the plant continues to assess the situation. Each loss of off-site power underscores the extremely fragile nuclear safety and security situation at the ZNPP, said DG @rafaelmgrossi, repeating his call for maximum restraint and protection of the plant’s external power supply.

Israel's problem is not primarily one of influence. It is a problem of strategy. No new public-diplomacy operation, influence unit or communications campaign — whether Bennett calls it "Unit 8300" or "Unit 83000" — can solve the fundamental challenge Israel faces in Washington and across the West. For years, Israeli leaders have increasingly treated the country's deteriorating international standing as a communications problem. If younger Americans are turning against Israel, the argument goes, Israel must be losing the information war. If criticism spreads across universities and social media, Qatar must be financing it. If Israel's image deteriorates, the answer is better messaging. There is certainly foreign influence in American politics, and Qatar's activities deserve scrutiny like those of any other state. But focusing on influence operations can become a convenient way to avoid a much harder question: What if much of the damage to Israel's standing is being caused by Israeli policy itself? Israel currently has no convincing diplomatic endgame for either Gaza or the broader Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Instead, its trajectory points toward recurring wars, permanent military control and an increasingly entrenched one-state reality. That is not a messaging problem. No communications strategy can indefinitely persuade Americans that a conflict has a political horizon when the government pursuing it offers none. Israel risks misdiagnosing the problem. If policymakers convince themselves that international criticism is primarily the product of Qatari money, hostile algorithms or insufficient Israeli advocacy, the logical response will always be another influence campaign. But, Israel's international position will not fundamentally improve until its strategy changes: until it can articulate a credible diplomatic objective, an alternative to perpetual war and a political future that does not simply lead toward permanent Israeli rule over millions of Palestinians. Public diplomacy can explain a strategy. It cannot substitute for one. The question facing Israel is not how to persuade the world to accept its current trajectory. It is whether that trajectory serves Israel's own long-term security, democratic character and relationship with the United States. Until Israeli leaders confront that question, blaming Qatar may be politically convenient. It will not solve Israel's problem. The CEO of Irregular, the AI security lab that ran evals where OpenAI models attacked real systems, just published his take on where AI security is headed. Key points: 1. Offensive AI is improving insanely fast One exploit task went: Impossible → ~$2,000/solve → ~$20/solve in 4 months. 2. More steps. Harder steps. Longer chains. AI is moving from finding bugs → writing exploits → chaining full attacks. 3. Autonomous campaigns are coming Recon → exploit → creds → persistence → lateral movement, with less human direction. 4. Attack cost is collapsing Better models + cheaper inference = far more attacks against far more targets. 5. AI is now the tool + target + attacker We have to secure what AI can do AND secure the AI itself. 6. Agents may hack to finish normal tasks We've already seen agents independently disable defenses or exploit systems when they become obstacles. 7. AI is the new insider risk Agents have reasoning + credentials + trusted access + tools. 8. Containment becomes its own security discipline People may need to worry about their own AI agents going rogue, hacking other systems or their own environment. Full article in the comments 👇

@AntonJaegermm: Why does so much of this contemporary political activity not translate itself very easily into concrete policy results?… One spectacular example of this: that there is now a long-standing majority in, let's say, public polling for public healthcare in the U.S. But there's actually negative correlation between that preference and the chances of it getting implemented, and I think that encapsulates the hyperpolitical paradox, where increased political activity without the institutional integument to make it stick, or let's say to affect an existing power structure, also means that there are not as many results, or it becomes more difficult.

What is hyperpolitics? @AntonJaegermm: Hyperpolitics is repoliticization without reinstitutionalization… as you see the curve going up in terms of politicization, as the definition indicates, you see another curve declining, namely membership rates for political parties, unions, civil society organizations, both on the left and the right.

Grok @Bot Stella Garber (@startupstella) Goodbye mental load....hellooooo @bot ! I know, I know. Grok Bot seems like it must be the next new thing for tech bros cold plunging in Patagonia vests, but hear me out moms (yes moms because disproportionately, the mental load falls more on moms than dads). Offload that mental load to AI and watch things just get done. Is it perfect? No. Is it amazing? Absolutely. Grok Bot is the new AI assistant from the team at Cursor + SpaceX (they're calling it SpaceXai). It's surprisingly useful and easy for non-technical people to use, and it can do a whole heck of a lot more than Claude and ChatGPT with little to no setup. Here are actual things that Grok Bot did for me this week (almost completely independently): - Looked through back to school emails and made sure I was prepared with everything that needed to be done for multiple kids. Mental load unlock: 100% I would've forgotten to pack a space change of clothes for my kindergartner on her first day. - Found 3 gift cards I somehow forgot to use from the last year. Oh right, I DID buy 2 Gap gift cards from Costco on black friday! Duh. Mental load unlock: Cha-ching! That's $150 in my pocket. - Scheduled multiple appointments for me. I've been putting off my annual physical exam because who has time to call the doctor. Grok Bot looked up options, pinged me with 3 dates/times, then booked it (I just had to confirm Zocdoc on the last step). It created a calendar reminder! Mental load unlock: Moms, we often put off our own health/wellbeing. Finally! AI can help. I also had it schedule a hair appt and massage for later this month. Let's go AI! - Listed a Facebook Marketplace item and is managing the sale. I had purchased a wagon for my kids years ago that's been collecting dust. Grok Bot found the old listing, used the photos, and asked me what $$ I want to list at. It's going to manage the rest (wish me luck here). Mental load unlock: Who has time to sell their old crap? I sure don't. But AI has infinite time. Notice, none of these are work examples. I will do those in a separate thread. All of these things are being done in the background, and I'm only being asked to approve or provide the AI direction. Don't be intimidated! Literally, if you've used WhatsApp or iMessage you can use Grok Bot with NO TRAINING. AMA I'm blown away by this tech. Photo is of my home assistant (her name is Helen) independently ordering my kindergartner a photo from Walgreens that mama somehow forgot about. Pakistan may have celebrated kills that were never kills. During Operation Sindoor, the IAF reportedly turned deception itself into a weapon. Rafale towed decoys, electronic warfare and unmanned false targets could create convincing tracks, forcing Pakistani radars and missiles to chase ghosts while the real strike package continued its mission. And there was a second trap: every air-defence radar that lit up to engage those decoys risked giving away its own position. That’s what makes modern air warfare fascinating. You detect a target. You lock it. You fire. You see the missile detonate. You celebrate a kill. Except the “fighter” you just killed may never have been a fighter at all. 🇮🇳

Two F-16AM Fighting Falcons with the Romanian Air Force were scrambled early Thursday to investigate an unidentified naval surface drone spotted near the Neptun Deep Project, a major European offshore natural gas field off the coast of Romania in the Black Sea. On approach, the drone - believed to be of Russian origin - was determined to be an active threat, with one of the F-16s using its M61A1 Vulcan Six-Barrel Gatling Gun to target and destroy the explosive-laden surface drone, roughly 80NM east of the Romanian Black Sea coastal city of Constanța. Romanian President Nicușor Dan blamed the incident on Russia, stating in a post online: “I strongly condemn the intensification of these types of irresponsible incidents on the part of the Russian Federation.” While European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen described it as part of an “escalating campaign of threats” against the European Union.

The FBI has raided former Rep. Eric Swalwell’s Washington home and seized electronic devices at San Francisco airport as part of a federal investigation into sexual assault allegations against him. The raid comes after Swalwell resigned from Congress and ended his campaign for governor of California in April following multiple allegations of sexual misconduct. The Manhattan DA and Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department are also investigating. Swalwell was previously linked to Christine Fang, or “Fang Fang,” a Chinese national investigated by the FBI as a suspected Chinese intelligence operative who had cultivated relationships with politically promising Bay Area politicians. Newly released FBI documents reportedly show Swalwell acknowledged having a sexual relationship with Fang between 2012 and 2015. Swalwell was briefed by U.S. intelligence about concerns surrounding Fang, cut off contact with her and cooperated with the FBI. He was never charged with wrongdoing, and the House Ethics Committee ultimately closed its investigation without action. Swalwell has denied the sexual-assault allegations.

"As an antidote to the succession of self-serving historiographical fads, I rely on two major sources of evidence – architecture and literature – both of which are difficult to distort." - Renaud Camus, Enemy of the Disaster Alicia, Courtyard Urbanist (@UrbanCourtyard) Aesthetics are about how we experience a thing. The word aesthetic comes from the Greek aisthēsis, meaning perception or sensation. When we experience a dense, fine-grained neighborhood, we don't just experience the facades. We are experiencing a place made up of many owners, many household types, many businesses, many buildings, and **many independent decisions.** A fine-grained neighborhood can capture a more granular picture of a people and society over time, and we like that. But we also like the orderliness and culture that is the necessary precondition of a dense, fine-grained neighborhood. To accommodate so many different people, institutions, property owners, and interests, a city needs shared norms, conventions, traditions, and rules that allow independent actors to build and live alongside one another without producing chaos. In other words, dense, fine-grained neighborhoods require a strong culture and community spirit. That is what a city and civilization are. So the facades strike us as beautiful partly because they are visible evidence of that achievement. They express a social, economic, and civic order capable of producing enormous complexity while still creating a (mostly) harmonious whole. That is, we are responding to the civilization the architecture embodies, and not just the architecture itself. That is why I prioritize differentiation in my courtyard-block designs, with clearly distinct buildings, varied rooflines, different facade rhythms, etc. AI does not naturally generate that kind of fine-grained urban complexity. If you simply ask it for a courtyard block, it will give you a single, overly unified megabuilding. My renderings begin with massing studies composed of many separate buildings. That underlying structure makes it much easier to preserve the diverse and layered character that make traditional urban blocks feel like cities rather than projects. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/UrbanCourtyard/status/2090441362885726329#m

🇵🇰 Today Ambassador @TahirAndrabi presided over the 1794th Plenary Meeting of the Conference on Disarmament in Geneva — the first plenary under Pakistan's Presidency of the 2026 session. In his inaugural statement as President: 🌍 He observed that the international security environment has deteriorated markedly in recent years — ▪️ armed conflicts across several regions ▪️ the erosion or lapse of key arms control instruments ▪️ the modernization and expansion of arsenals ▪️ the rapid advance of new technologies in outer space, the cyber domain and artificial intelligence, outpacing the frameworks meant to govern them. The world has grown more dangerous, and the need for this Conference more acute. 🚌 Cautioning against attributing the Conference's long impasse to its machinery, the CD President recalled that it was this same body — operating under essentially the same rules — that negotiated the landmark instruments of the international security architecture. When the passengers on a bus cannot agree on a destination, he noted, the fault does not lie with the bus. 🏛️ He underlined that the Conference remains an institution the international community would struggle to rebuild if it did not exist — one that brings together all militarily significant States, on the basis of agreed rules, with decades of accumulated expertise behind it. 📑 As the final President of the 2026 session, Pakistan's central responsibility is the Conference's Annual Report to the UN General Assembly. The President called on all delegations to bring cooperation, constructive spirit and flexibility to enable its timely adoption by consensus. 🤝 He assured members that the Presidency's doors remain open to every delegation. 📄 Full text of the statement attached. #Pakistan #Disarmament #Geneva #ConferenceOnDisarmament

He writes “Israel's international position will not fundamentally improve until its strategy changes: until it can articulate a credible diplomatic objective, an alternative to perpetual war and a political future that does not simply lead toward permanent Israeli rule over millions of Palestinians. Public diplomacy can explain a strategy. It cannot substitute for one.” Danny (Dennis) Citrinowicz ,داني سيترينوفيتش (@citrinowicz) Israel's problem is not primarily one of influence. It is a problem of strategy. No new public-diplomacy operation, influence unit or communications campaign — whether Bennett calls it "Unit 8300" or "Unit 83000" — can solve the fundamental challenge Israel faces in Washington and across the West. For years, Israeli leaders have increasingly treated the country's deteriorating international standing as a communications problem. If younger Americans are turning against Israel, the argument goes, Israel must be losing the information war. If criticism spreads across universities and social media, Qatar must be financing it. If Israel's image deteriorates, the answer is better messaging. There is certainly foreign influence in American politics, and Qatar's activities deserve scrutiny like those of any other state. But focusing on influence operations can become a convenient way to avoid a much harder question: What if much of the damage to Israel's standing is being caused by Israeli policy itself? Israel currently has no convincing diplomatic endgame for either Gaza or the broader Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Instead, its trajectory points toward recurring wars, permanent military control and an increasingly entrenched one-state reality. That is not a messaging problem. No communications strategy can indefinitely persuade Americans that a conflict has a political horizon when the government pursuing it offers none. Israel risks misdiagnosing the problem. If policymakers convince themselves that international criticism is primarily the product of Qatari money, hostile algorithms or insufficient Israeli advocacy, the logical response will always be another influence campaign. But, Israel's international position will not fundamentally improve until its strategy changes: until it can articulate a credible diplomatic objective, an alternative to perpetual war and a political future that does not simply lead toward permanent Israeli rule over millions of Palestinians. Public diplomacy can explain a strategy. It cannot substitute for one. The question facing Israel is not how to persuade the world to accept its current trajectory. It is whether that trajectory serves Israel's own long-term security, democratic character and relationship with the United States. Until Israeli leaders confront that question, blaming Qatar may be politically convenient. It will not solve Israel's problem. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/citrinowicz/status/2090078583934836876#m

Photo | Jammu and Kashmir: A public delegation from Punjab, led by S Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal, Member of Legislative Assembly from Ajnala, Amritsar, called on Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha and briefed him on recurring monsoon overflows from the Ujh River, affecting several parts of Punjab. The delegation requested the Lieutenant Governor to take up the matter with Prime Minister Narendra Modi the Union Jal Shakti Minister CR Patil for construction of a suitable dam or reservoir project on River Ujh, or any other technically feasible flood-moderation measure, after undertaking a comprehensive feasibility study and preparation of a Detailed Project Report. The delegation highlighted that such a project could help regulate and maintain the flow of River Ujh and mitigate flood situations in several districts of Punjab, including Pathankot, Gurdaspur and Amritsar, particularly Ajnala Sub-Division. It was further submitted that besides flood management, a reservoir project could facilitate the storage of excess monsoon water for future use, while also offering potential for hydroelectric power generation and promoting tourism, water-sports and recreational activities in the area. The delegation emphasised that the proposed intervention could contribute to long-term water management, strengthen flood resilience and support sustainable economic development in the region. Israel's problem is not primarily one of influence. It is a problem of strategy. No new public-diplomacy operation, influence unit or communications campaign — whether Bennett calls it "Unit 8300" or "Unit 83000" — can solve the fundamental challenge Israel faces in Washington and across the West. For years, Israeli leaders have increasingly treated the country's deteriorating international standing as a communications problem. If younger Americans are turning against Israel, the argument goes, Israel must be losing the information war. If criticism spreads across universities and social media, Qatar must be financing it. If Israel's image deteriorates, the answer is better messaging. There is certainly foreign influence in American politics, and Qatar's activities deserve scrutiny like those of any other state. But focusing on influence operations can become a convenient way to avoid a much harder question: What if much of the damage to Israel's standing is being caused by Israeli policy itself? Israel currently has no convincing diplomatic endgame for either Gaza or the broader Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Instead, its trajectory points toward recurring wars, permanent military control and an increasingly entrenched one-state reality. That is not a messaging problem. No communications strategy can indefinitely persuade Americans that a conflict has a political horizon when the government pursuing it offers none. Israel risks misdiagnosing the problem. If policymakers convince themselves that international criticism is primarily the product of Qatari money, hostile algorithms or insufficient Israeli advocacy, the logical response will always be another influence campaign. But, Israel's international position will not fundamentally improve until its strategy changes: until it can articulate a credible diplomatic objective, an alternative to perpetual war and a political future that does not simply lead toward permanent Israeli rule over millions of Palestinians. Public diplomacy can explain a strategy. It cannot substitute for one. The question facing Israel is not how to persuade the world to accept its current trajectory. It is whether that trajectory serves Israel's own long-term security, democratic character and relationship with the United States. Until Israeli leaders confront that question, blaming Qatar may be politically convenient. It will not solve Israel's problem. Yeah, so pretty much everyone and their Grandmother is still discussing this GTA VI leak and/or compromise. Unsurprisingly, the game leaks have also generated a great deal of speculation. Grand Theft Auto is a gigantic franchise, Rockstar is a multi-billion dollar company, and their newest release into their franchise will probably be another banger. My educated guess, based off of everything I've seen online, is that this is the result of information stealing malware. My reasoning for this is that several people online have noted that some Rockstar employees appear to have accidentally detonated malware on their computers which subsequently exfiltrated their sensitive usernames, passwords, and web sessions. A Threat Actor getting access to sensitive corporate data, as a result of an employee infecting themselves with malware on their personal devices, is a tale as old as time itself. This sort of threat to organizations however is typically not targeted. While it is possible "Mr. Leek" intentionally targeted Rockstar employees (spearphishing), I believe this to be unlikely. Based off of the malware logs others have shared, I believe a Threat Actor began their typical malware campaign, to steal peoples credentials, credit-cards, cryptocurrencies, etc, and by the grace of God inadvertently infected an employee at Rockstar games. Threat Actors are opportunists. Upon seeing he had infected a Rockstar Games employee, which would grant them access to insider information at Rockstar, I believe this person immediately seized the moment to profit off of it (or gain notoriety). It's important to note that I could be wrong in my assessment. I am coming to this conclusion off of one angle, it is not outside the realm of possibility this was spearphishing, ... or something even sillier like an exposed bucket, or something. None of it would really surprise me, mistakes happen, organizations are compromised daily, and when you're a company as large as Rockstar you have a massive target on your back. Pic unrelated

🇮🇱🇺🇸🇹🇷🇸🇾 Israel is pushing back against a U.S. initiative to create a deconfliction mechanism with Turkey and Syria. • The effort, led by U.S. Special Envoy Tom Barrack, aims to prevent an unintended Israeli-Turkish confrontation in Syria • Washington’s message to Jerusalem: fewer surprises, more coordination • Israeli officials see a larger danger: the mechanism could gradually evolve into a framework requiring advance warnings, intelligence sharing, and coordination, eventually restricting Israel’s freedom of action in Syria • Jerusalem’s preference is to prevent Turkish military entrenchment in Syria altogether, rather than reach a point where it must coordinate Turkish activity with Ankara • Deep distrust of Syria’s new regime and its growing Turkish influence is also driving the resistance • Israel even prefers direct messaging with Syria, as in the case of Mossad Chief Roman Gofman, who called Syria’s Foreign Minister to discuss the Turkish deployment prior to the Israeli strike on the Syrian airbase earlier this week • According to sources, there has been no direct line of communication between Jerusalem and Ankara this week • This initiative is not merely a technical deconfliction tool, it could reshape the strategic reality in Syria • Turkey’s Defense Ministry denied any Turkish military presence at the airbase before or during Israel’s recent strike, while acknowledging that Ankara “continues to support Syria and its efforts to develop its military capabilities and infrastructure” • Defense Minister Israel Katz sent out an explicit warning: “Erdogan is dragging Turkey into dangerous adventures in Syria. Israel will not allow any actor to threaten its security.”

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 received a telephone call from the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Federative Republic of Brazil, H.E. Ambassador Mauro Vieira. The Brazilian Foreign Minister commended Pakistan’s constructive role and efforts towards mediation in the US-Iran context, underscoring the importance of dialogue and diplomacy for global peace and security. He also felicitated DPM/FM on Pakistan’s signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement. DPM/FM thanked him for his kind sentiments and appreciated Brazil’s important role in advancing South-South cooperation and commitment towards peace and stability. The two sides underscored the importance of sustained high-level contacts and close coordination at the UN and other multilateral forums, reaffirming their commitment to multilateralism, dialogue and diplomacy. Both sides also exchanged views on regional and international developments and agreed to remain closely engaged to further advance Pakistan-Brazil relations. DPM/FM invited the Brazilian Foreign Minister to visit Pakistan, while H.E. Mauro Vieira reciprocated with an invitation to visit Brazil. Both agreed to remain closely connected and look forward to further strengthening bilateral ties. @PakinBrazil

How do you build a sensory-safe home? How do you truly support a non-verbal child, or prepare them for a confident life after school? These are not small questions, they are the deeply personal, everyday anxieties of parents who want nothing more than to see their children thrive. Every parent deserves clear answers, expert guidance, and unwavering support. That is precisely why we established the Parent Training Program at the Maryam Nawaz School & Resource Centre for Autism. Our vision is to empower families with structured, practical tools tailored for real life at home, covering essential therapies, daily routines, functional communication, and emotional well-being. To date, we have successfully completed 14 structured training modules, directly equipping caregivers with the skills they need. No parent in Punjab should ever have to walk this journey alone. We are standing right beside you every step of the way. Video

Behind every child's progress is a skilled hand, an empathetic heart, and a deeply prepared mind. True transformation in special education does not come from brick and mortar alone, it begins with the people who walk these halls every single day. That is why our staff at the Maryam Nawaz School & Resource Centre for Autism have undergone rigorous, specialized training under top national and international experts. We are building a world-class workforce in Punjab, equipped with the highest global standards in autism care, compassionate therapy, and modern intervention strategies. This is how we create lasting, meaningful change for our children and their families by investing in the extraordinary dedicated professionals who guide them toward a brighter, more independent future. कांग्रेस अब अपनी हार की हताशा और कुंठा में अपने आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल्स के जरिए लगातार झूठे, भ्रामक और पूरी तरह फैब्रिकेटेड (fabricated) पोस्ट कर रही है। हमारे राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष श्री नितिन नवीन जी के आंध्र प्रदेश दौरे के दौरान पार्टी नेताओं के साथ सार्वजनिक भोजन को लेकर छत्तीसगढ़ कांग्रेस ने अपने आधिकारिक X हैंडल से एक पोस्ट किया, जो निहायत झूठा, निंदनीय और भ्रामक था। इससे पहले भी 15 अगस्त को कांग्रेस पार्टी और उसके नेताओं के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल्स से राष्ट्रीय ध्वज को लेकर भ्रामक प्रचार किया गया। कहीं भाजपा के कार्यक्रमों के वीडियो को स्वतंत्रता दिवस का बताकर पेश किया गया, तो कहीं राष्ट्रीय ध्वज को उल्टा दिखाकर अनर्गल दुष्प्रचार किया गया। कांग्रेस जो कर रही है, यह उसकी बेहद गलत और खतरनाक फितरत है। 2024 के चुनाव में भी तेलंगाना कांग्रेस ने गृहमंत्री जी का एक edited वीडियो अपने आधिकारिक हैंडल से push किया था। मामला सामने आने और इसकी सच्चाई साबित होने के बाद कानूनी कार्रवाई भी हुई थी। इसलिए हम कहना चाहते हैं कि पिछले दो वर्षों से जो सिलसिला चल रहा था, कांग्रेस उसे लगातार आगे बढ़ा रही है। अपनी हार की हताशा और कुंठा में वह अब छिछोरेपन की उस सीमा तक पहुंच गई है, जहां हमारे राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष जी को लेकर भी झूठा और भ्रामक प्रचार किया जा रहा है। भारतीय जनता पार्टी इसकी घोर निंदा करती है। यह राजनीतिक और नैतिक रूप से तो निंदनीय है ही, साथ-साथ कानूनी दृष्टि से भी अत्यंत गंभीर विषय है। कांग्रेस जिस तरह हमारे शीर्ष नेतृत्व और राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष जी को लेकर झूठा और भ्रामक प्रचार कर रही है, मैं कांग्रेस पार्टी से कहना चाहूंगा: "सच जरा सा घटे या बढ़े तो सच, सच न रहे, मगर झूठ की तो कोई इंतहा नहीं।" "लाख चेहरे बदल के आ जाते हैं ये, पर आइना कमबख्त झूठ बोलता ही नहीं।" - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video

Another day of heightened aerial activity near the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad. Thanks to reporting from @thewarzonewire's @Haltman, we now know the activity is part of a U.S.-led NATO exercise that also includes a ground component involving Polish armed forces, although their specific role has not been disclosed. Several U.S. Air Force and NATO tankers are operating in refueling racetrack orbits over Polish airspace, while a NATO E-3 AWACS is orbiting just north of the tanker tracks. A U.S. Air Force EA-37B "Compass Call II" electronic-warfare aircraft has also made the trip into the area again, this time flying directly from Chania, Greece, before operating near Kaliningrad. A NATO official told The War Zone that the exercise is not in response to recent Russian military activity or rhetoric. However, comments from a Polish official appeared to indicate that deterrence is part of the broader purpose of the exercise. The activity remains notable given the concentration of airborne early warning, electronic warfare, ISR and aerial refueling capabilities operating in close proximity to Kaliningrad.

Just across the water from Macao Special Administrative Region (SAR) in south China, a new community is taking shape in Hengqin, south China's Guangdong Province. The Macao New Neighborhood is the first residential project on the Chinese mainland specifically for Macao SAR residents. Stretching over 190,000 square meters, it has 27 buildings, 4,200 apartments and green spaces covering 35% of the area. It's more than just housing. It brings together education, healthcare and other public services, creating a community where Macao families can settle and thrive. The neighborhood is a flagship project of the Guangdong-Macao In-Depth Cooperation Zone, set up in 2021. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. In his recent article in the @htTweets, @SomitDasgupta, flags the issue of lack of storage capacity in India, be it batteries or pumped storage. Dasgupta argues that solar capacity has exceeded 162 GW and the combined generation from renewable capacity and conventional capacity is, at times, exceeding the demand during solar hours. This is despite the fact that coal based generators may be operating at their technical minimum, meaning going down any further will only damage the machines. Consequently, solar generators are being asked to back down, disturbing their economics. Dasgupta adds that had storage been available, the excess daytime power could be used to charge the batteries and also to pump water from the lower reservoir to the higher reservoir in pump storage plants. There seems to be no possibility of immediate relief since the completion of ongoing storage schemes is doubtful due to non-remunerative tariffs arrived at through competitive bidding. Foreign Minister of the Syrian Arab Republic Mr. Asaad Hassan Al-Shaibani called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad on 20 August 2026.

ISLAMABAD: 20 August 2026. Foreign Minister of the Syrian Arab Republic, Mr. Asaad Hassan Al-Shaibani, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif today. Welcoming Mr. Al-Shaibani and his delegation, the Prime Minister conveyed his best wishes for President Ahmed al-Sharaa, and recalled his recent interactions with him. He also reaffirmed Pakistan's steadfast support for the sovereignty, unity, and territorial integrity of Syria. While recalling the historic and multifaceted ties between the two countries, the Prime Minister emphasized the need to translate the longstanding Pakistan-Syria friendship into enhanced cooperation across politics, defence, trade, investment, education, and human resource development. He stated that the resumption of direct flights between the two countries would enhance people-to-people exchanges and facilitate a large number of pilgrims who undertake religious visits to Syria from Pakistan. The Prime Minister reaffirmed Pakistan’s support for Syria’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity and said Pakistan would firmly support Syria’s position on the Golan Heights. The Syrian Foreign Minister conveyed the greetings of Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa to the Prime Minister, and briefed him on Syria's ongoing political transition and reconstruction efforts. He thanked Pakistan for its consistent support to Syria throughout the past years and expressed his government's keen interest in revitalizing bilateral engagement, including through early institutional mechanisms for cooperation. The Prime Minister also extended an invitation to President Ahmed al-Sharaa to undertake an official visit to Pakistan at a mutually convenient date. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Muhammad Ishaq Dar, SAPM Syed Tariq Fatemi and Foreign Secretary Amb. Amna Baloch were also present during the meeting. Video

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 chaired the 7th meeting on strengthening trade and economic engagement with friendly countries, particularly with the EU. The meeting discussed ways to accelerate trade and economic partnerships with friendly countries, including improving market access, export performance, and coordination among relevant stakeholders. DPM/FM stressed the importance of effective follow-up on commitments and conventions under the GSP+ framework as well. DPM/FM directed all concerned to accord priority to enhancing Pakistan’s trade and export performance, ensuring timely implementation of agreed measures, and strengthening coordination to maximise market access and economic opportunities for Pakistan. The meeting was attended by Minister of Commerce, SAPM Tariq Bajwa, Federal Secretary of Foreign Affairs Amna Baloch, Federal Secretaries of Commerce, Interior, Pakistan’s Ambassador to Brussels, Chairman CDA, and federal and provincial senior officials from concerned ministries and departments.

Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member (Health), NITI Aayog, chaired a multi-stakeholder consultation on Neurodevelopmental Disorders in the paediatric age group, bringing together representatives from the Ministries of Health & Family Welfare, Social Justice & Empowerment, and Education; leading academic institutions including AIIMS New Delhi, NIMHANS Bengaluru, IHBAS Delhi and CMC Vellore; research organisations such as ICMR; and NGOs including Ramakrishna Mission and The Hans Foundation. The discussions focused on early identification, timely intervention, interdisciplinary care, strengthening service delivery, and inter-sectoral convergence, with emphasis on the importance of the first 1,000 days of life. The consultation highlighted the need for a whole-of-government, whole-of-society and evidence-based approach to strengthen neurodevelopmental care for Autism Spectrum Disorders, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorders, Cerebral Palsy and other neurodevelopmental disorders. These efforts can help improve access to rehabilitation and support services and enable every child to achieve their full developmental potential. #Neurodevelopment #ChildHealth @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, met Dr. Manik Saha, Chief Minister of Tripura, during her visit to the State, along with senior officials of NITI Aayog, to discuss key development priorities and opportunities for collaboration between the State Government and NITI Aayog. The discussions focused on School Education, Tourism, Sports, Innovation & Entrepreneurship/Startups, identified as key priority areas for Tripura’s development. Particular emphasis was placed on strengthening the education ecosystem through the expansion of Vidya Jyoti, Ashram and Eklavya Model Residential Schools, Smart Class initiatives, and targeted interventions to reduce school dropout rates. The meeting also covered strategies to unlock the potential of Tripura’s Bamboo, Horticulture and Fishery sectors, strengthen innovation and entrepreneurship through collaboration with the Atal Innovation Mission, and advance connectivity and infrastructure priorities, including railway connectivity and the development of Kailashahar and Kamalpur airports. Discussions on tourism focused on developing the Buddhist Circuit, promoting homestays, and leveraging Tripura’s cultural, spiritual and natural heritage, including the conservation and sustainable development of Unakoti. The meeting reaffirmed the commitment to Centre–State collaboration, knowledge sharing and outcome-oriented interventions to accelerate Tripura’s development and contribute to the vision of Viksit Bharat. #Tripura #NorthEastIndia @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

For almost 50 years, @IFAD has worked to ensure that women have greater access to the assets, finance, markets and decision-making needed to contribute to and benefit from economic growth. The economic case is clear. Greater equality strengthens productivity, resilience and the performance of rural economies. IFAD’s Gender Transformative Mechanism in Climate Adaptation (GTM) is helping translate that ambition into investment at scale. The US$26.25 million facility has already influenced more than US$118.5 million in climate investments across IFAD-financed projects, integrating gender equality into how climate and development finance is designed and delivered. That is translating into stronger land rights in Burkina Faso, greater participation in agricultural cooperatives in Ethiopia, and new climate-smart businesses led by women in India. The mechanism, financed with @gatesfoundation, Germany’s @BMZ_Bund, and @ZontaIntl aims to empower more than 5 million people across 20 countries by 2030. Through our partnership with @FAO and Commit to Grow Equality, IFAD is sharing lessons and results from initiatives such as the GTM and its wider portfolio, highlighting approaches that can mobilize investment, strengthen institutions and expand economic opportunities for rural women. When women can invest, produce, own assets and access markets on equal terms, rural economies become stronger and more resilient. Зараз триває ліквідація наслідків російського удару по столиці й містах Київщини. Понад 600 рятувальників ДСНС України та поліцейських залучено до робіт у Києві, Броварах і Борисполі. Вдячний усім, хто допомагає нашим людям. Загалом тільки в Києві та області пошкоджено 30 житлових будинків, звичайну школу, дитячу лікарню і дитячий садок. На жаль, станом на зараз у Києві відомо про 15 загиблих людей. Мої співчуття всім, хто втратив рідних і близьких. Важливо, щоб людям, які були поранені, надавалась уся необхідна допомога. І важливо, щоб партнери України не мовчали про цей та інші подібні удари й справді допомагали захисту наших людей, захисту життя в Україні. Цей російський удар був одним із найбільш цинічних, прорахованих і масштабних. Були ракети різних типів і 168 дронів. Наші воїни сьогодні збили всі російські «калібри». Загалом відсоток збиття крилатих ракет – 93%, і також значний відсоток збиття дронів. Найбільша загроза – балістика. І це те, що повністю залежить від постачання ракет для «петріотів» для України, а отже, залежить від партнерів нашої держави. Не можна просто тихо, байдуже й бездіяльно споглядати, як росіяни руйнують життя балістикою. Українські воїни можуть діяти майстерно, коли сміливість і фаховість наших людей підтримані відповідною допомогою наших партнерів. Дякую всім, хто з Україною!

The greatest threat is ballistic missiles. And this is something that depends entirely on the supply of Patriot missiles to Ukraine and therefore depends on our country’s partners. You cannot simply watch silently and indifferently, doing nothing as the Russians destroy lives with ballistic missiles. Ukrainian warriors can operate with great skill when the courage and professionalism of our people are backed by the appropriate support from our partners. खेला जा रहा है. पाकिस्तान के खिलाफ इस टेस्ट मैच की पहली पारी में 13 रन और बनाते ही इंग्लैंड के दिग्गज बल्लेबाज जो रूट टेस्ट क्रिकेट में इतिहास रच देंगे. जो रूट ऐसा करते ही महान बल्लेबाज सचिन तेंदुलकर का वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड तोड़ देंगे. बता दें कि इंग्लैंड ने इस टेस्ट मैच में टॉस जीतकर गेंदबाजी चुनी और हेडिंग्ले क्रिकेट ग्राउंड की बॉलिंग फ्रेंडली विकेट पर पाकिस्तान को पहले बल्लेबाजी का न्योता दिया. इंग्लैंड के लिए ओली रोबिंसन और जोश टंग ने इसके बाद मिलकर अपनी कातिलाना गेंदबाजी से पाकिस्तान की पहली पारी को 48.1 ओवर में 171 रन पर समेट दिया. ओली रोबिंसन और जोश टंग इंग्लैंड के इन दोनों ही घातक तेज गेंदबाजों ने 5-5 विकेट झटके. इंग्लैंड ने इसके बाद अपनी पहली पारी में अभी तक 25 ओवर में 2 विकेट गंवाकर 112 रन बना लिए हैं. जो रूट (37 रन) और जॉर्डन कॉक्स (23 रन) क्रीज पर मौजूद हैं. जो रूट अगर 13 रन और बना लेते हैं, तो वह टेस्ट क्रिकेट में सबसे कम पारियों में सबसे ज्यादा 68 अर्धशतक जड़ने के मामले में सचिन तेंदुलकर को पीछे छोड़ देंगे. . . टेस्ट क्रिकेट में फिलहाल सबसे ज्यादा अर्धशतक जड़ने का वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड भारत के महान बल्लेबाज सचिन तेंदुलकर के नाम पर दर्ज है. सचिन तेंदुलकर ने 329 टेस्ट पारियों में 68 अर्धशतक जड़ने का वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड बनाया था. वहीं, जो रूट के पास सचिन तेंदुलकर से भी कम 305 पारियों में 68 टेस्ट अर्धशतक जड़ने का वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड बनाने का मौका है. इस बड़ी उपलब्धि के साथ ही इंग्लैंड का यह स्टार बल्लेबाज सचिन तेंदुलकर को भी पीछे छोड़ देगा. जो रूट के पास अपने घर में सबसे ज्यादा With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের মোট সরকারি ঋণ প্রথমবারের মতো ৪০ ট্রিলিয়ন (৪০ লাখ কোটি) ডলার ছাড়িয়েছে। সামাজিক নিরাপত্তা কর্মসূচি ও সুদ পরিশোধ করতে গিয়ে ব্যয় যেভাবে হু হু করে বাড়ছে, সে তুলনায় করছাড়ের কারণে রাজস্ব আদায় অনেক কম হচ্ছে। ফলে এক বড় ধরনের আর্থিক সংকটের আশঙ্কা করা হচ্ছে। যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়ের সর্বশেষ দৈনিক নগদ অর্থ ও ঋণস্থিতি বিবরণী অনুযায়ী, গত মঙ্গলবার সরকারি ঋণের পরিমাণ বেড়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে ৪০ দশমিক শূন্য ৪৭ ট্রিলিয়ন (৪০ লাখ ৪ হাজার ৭০০ কোটি) ডলার। এর মধ্যে জনগণের কাছে থাকা ট্রেজারি সিকিউরিটিজের পরিমাণ ৩২ দশমিক ২৬৬ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার ও সরকারের বিভিন্ন সংস্থার ঋণ ৭ দশমিক ৭৮২ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার। মাত্র এক দশকের কম সময়ে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের সরকারি ঋণ দ্বিগুণের বেশি বেড়েছে। ২০১৭ সালের জানুয়ারিতে ডোনাল্ড ট্রাম্প প্রথমবার প্রেসিডেন্টের দায়িত্ব নেওয়ার সময় দেশটির সরকারি ঋণ ছিল ১৯ দশমিক ৯৫ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার। সরকারি ঋণ বৃদ্ধির প্রায় এক-তৃতীয়াংশই ঘটেছে ট্রাম্প ও সাবেক প্রেসিডেন্ট জো বাইডেনের আমলে কোভিড-১৯ মহামারির ধাক্কা সামলাতে সরকারের নেওয়া জরুরি ঋণ কর্মসূচির কারণে। বাকি দুই-তৃতীয়াংশ ঋণের জন্য দায়ী এ দুই প্রেসিডেন্টের নেওয়া আর্থিক নীতি এবং দীর্ঘদিনের কর ও ব্যয়ের মধ্যকার কাঠামোগত ভারসাম্যহীনতা। #USDebt #USeconomy #GlobalEconomy #somoytv

Dr. Ashok K. Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, addressed the ICRA Leadership Summit on “Reframing Perspectives on Corporate India and Infrastructure amid Evolving Headwinds” in New Delhi. In his address, Dr. Lahiri highlighted India’s strong economic fundamentals and emphasised the need for continued momentum to achieve the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047. He underscored the importance of rapid industrialisation, greater corporate investment, technology adoption, and stronger manufacturing and export capabilities to drive productivity, employment, and growth. Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 held wide-ranging delegation-level talks with Syrian Foreign Minister H.E. Mr. Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani, welcoming his visit to Pakistan. The two sides reaffirmed the longstanding brotherly ties between Pakistan and Syria and agreed to further strengthen bilateral cooperation across areas of mutual interest. The Ministers also exchanged views on regional and international developments, including Palestine, the Golan Heights, Afghanistan, the situation in South Asia, and developments in the Middle East. DPM/FM reaffirmed Pakistan’s support for Syria’s sovereignty, unity, and territorial integrity. The Syrian Foreign Minister welcomed the signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement and commended Pakistan’s constructive role in promoting regional peace and stability, including its efforts towards de-escalation in the US-Iran context. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to continued engagement and cooperation for peace, stability, and prosperity in the region and beyond.

ইউক্রেনের রাজধানী কিয়েভে রাশিয়ার ব্যালিস্টিক ক্ষেপণাস্ত্রের হামলায় অন্তত ১২ জন নিহত হয়েছে। বৃহস্পতিবার (২০ আগস্ট) ভোর রাতের এ হামলায় আরও ৩০ জনের বেশি আহত, বহু ভবন ও বিদ্যুৎ সরবরাহ ব্যবস্থা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে বলে জানিয়েছে কিয়েভ কর্তৃপক্ষ। কিয়েভের মেয়র ভিতালি ক্লিচকো জানান, নগরীর সলোমিয়ানস্কি এলাকায় ৯তলা একটি আবাসিক ব্লক ধ্বংস হয়ে গেছে, এর ওপরের তলাগুলোতে আগুন ধরে যায়, আর সেখানে সাতজনের মৃত্যু হয়। তিনি শুক্রবার (২১ আগস্ট) এক দিনের শোক পালনের আহ্বান জানিয়েছেন। খবর রয়টার্সের। হামলায় কিয়েভের আরও দুটি এলাকা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে বলে টেলিগ্রাম অ্যাপে ক্লিচকো জানিয়েছেন। এ এলাকাগুলোতে বিভিন্ন স্থাপনা, গুদাম, একটি স্কুল ও একটি শিশু হাসপাতালে আঘাত লেগেছে। বিদ্যুৎ কোম্পানি ডিটিইকে জানায়, হামলার পর প্রায় ৯০ হাজার বাড়ি বিদ্যুৎবিহীন হয়ে পড়ে, তবে এর মধ্যে তারা অর্ধেকের বেশি বাড়ির বিদ্যুৎ সরবরাহ সচল করেছে। #InternationalNews #news #somoytv

Dholavira, one of the finest urban centres of the Sindhu-Saraswati Civilization, has yielded what is regarded as the largest known stone sculpture from the entire civilization spread across the northwestern part of the Indian Subcontinent. Found during the excavations near the Eastern Gate of the Castle, this large sculpture is more than just an artefact. It stands as living evidence of a sophisticated artistic tradition of stone sculpting that began over 4,500 years ago and has continued unbroken in India. From such monumental works of the Indus-Saraswati era to the modern craft of stone sculpting, India has preserved and carried forward this civilizational thread. Dholavira does not merely preserve the past, it affirms that the creative genius of the Sindhu-Saraswati Civilization continues to beat throughout India. #LivingContinuity #SindhuSaraswati #IndusValley #Indus #IndusValleyCivilization

In his recent article in the @htTweets, @SomitDasgupta, flags the issue of lack of storage capacity in India, be it batteries or pumped storage. Dasgupta argues that solar capacity has exceeded 162 GW and the combined generation from renewable capacity and conventional capacity is, at times, exceeding the demand during solar hours. This is despite the fact that coal based generators may be operating at their technical minimum, meaning going down any further will only damage the machines. Consequently, solar generators are being asked to back down, disturbing their economics. Dasgupta adds that had storage been available, the excess daytime power could be used to charge the batteries and also to pump water from the lower reservoir to the higher reservoir in pump storage plants. There seems to be no possibility of immediate relief since the completion of ongoing storage schemes is doubtful due to non-remunerative tariffs arrived at through competitive bidding. The IAEA has been informed that the 330 kV Ferosplavna-1 power line at the Zaporizhzhya NPP – the plant’s only remaining off-site power line - was disconnected at 00:44 local time today resulting in a new loss of off-site power. The location of the damage to the line was preliminarily assessed to be on the northern bank of the Dnipro River. An attempt to reconnect the line manually was unsuccessful and, due to ongoing military activity, technicians are currently unable to determine the cause of the outage. Emergency diesel generators automatically started up to power the plants vital safety systems. The IAEA team at the plant continues to assess the situation. Each loss of off-site power underscores the extremely fragile nuclear safety and security situation at the ZNPP, said DG @rafaelmgrossi, repeating his call for maximum restraint and protection of the plant’s external power supply.

Fifty years ago, ASEAN turned a shared aspiration for peace into a lasting commitment. Signed in 1976, the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) established principles of mutual respect, non-interference, peaceful settlement of disputes, renunciation of the threat or use of force, and effective cooperation. What began as an agreement among ASEAN’s founding members gradually grew alongside the region. As ASEAN expanded, all eleven ASEAN Member States came together under the TAC's principles, while partners from beyond Southeast Asia also joined this commitment to peaceful relations and cooperation. Today, as ASEAN commemorates the 50th Anniversary of the TAC, the Treaty reflects how a regional commitment made five decades ago has grown into a framework connecting ASEAN with partners around the world. At its heart remains a simple belief: lasting peace begins with dialogue, mutual respect, and cooperation. #ASEAN59 #TAC50 #NavigatingOurFutureTogether Video

STORY | Even ministers' dogs get better facilities: Dipke on condition of govt schools Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) convenor Abhijeet Dipke on Thursday said Maharashtra School Education Minister Dada Bhuse should resign, claiming government schools are in a pitiable condition and that even "ministers’ dogs get better facilities" than students. Dipke, whose group launched the ‘School Thik Karo’ (improve government schools) campaign last week, visited a Zilla Parishad school at Ujani village in Latur's Ausa tehsil. Later, talking to reporters, he said elected representatives and ministers must be held accountable for the condition of schools, many of which continue to lack basic facilities such as proper classrooms, benches, toilets and safe access roads. Students in some schools were being treated "worse than animals", he alleged. "It is a question of students' lives. When political leaders are not doing anything for students, why should people vote for them? Do people vote for them so that they can only travel in helicopters? People should see in what conditions their children are studying. The dogs of these ministers get better facilities than this," he said. Dipke also asked people to force the leaders of political parties to work for education first and then come to seek votes. READ: ptinews.com/story/national/e…

250,000 books. That is how many my Ukrainian publisher, Knygolove knigolove.ua/ lost on 19 July after three Russian Iskander missiles struck the warehouse outside Kyiv. Among them were my books, too. This is war, and war inevitably brings human and material losses. But when books burn, it is not just paper that burns. Culture, memory, and identity burn with them. So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

Con el traspaso de la Presidencia Pro Tempore de Paraguay a Uruguay, comenzó una nueva etapa de trabajo de la Reunión de Altas Autoridades sobre Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR (RAADDHH). Luego del trabajo desarrollado durante el primer semestre bajo la Presidencia Pro Tempore del Paraguay, Uruguay asumió la conducción de la RAADDHH para el segundo semestre de 2026, con una agenda orientada a fortalecer el diálogo político, la cooperación y la construcción de consensos regionales en materia de Derechos Humanos. Durante la apertura, la Secretaria de Derechos Humanos del Uruguay, Iliana da Silva, destacó especialmente el papel del Instituto de Políticas Públicas de Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR (IPPDDHH) y reafirmó el compromiso de su país con su consolidación y fortalecimiento: “Queremos subrayar la importancia del Instituto de Políticas Públicas de Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR, el IPPDDHH, como un actor fundamental para el fortalecimiento de nuestras políticas regionales. También queremos reafirmar nuestro compromiso con su consolidación y fortalecerlo, y destacar el valioso aporte que realiza en la promoción y protección de los Derechos Humanos en el proceso de integración.” Entre las prioridades planteadas para esta nueva etapa se encuentra la salud mental como eje prioritario y transversal, con el objetivo de promover respuestas articuladas e integrales por parte de entre los Estados Partes. 🔗Más información aquí: bit.ly/4gGOhUw

রিয়াল মাদ্রিদের কিংবদন্তি ব্রাজিলিয়ান ফুটবলার রবার্তো কার্লোস ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেছেন, সম্প্রতি এমন খবর ছড়িয়ে পড়ে। তবে এ খবরকে সরাসরি ‘অসত্য’ বলে দাবি করেছেন তিনি। তুরস্কের কয়েকটি সংবাদমাধ্যমে বলা হয়, মরক্কোর নাগরিক সুহাইলা আল-তাহিরিকে বিয়ের পর প্রায় চার সপ্তাহ আগে ব্রাজিলের মুসলিম ব্যক্তিত্ব শায়খ জিহাদ হামাদার কাছে শাহাদাহ পাঠ করে ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেন কার্লোস। তুরস্কের সংসদ সদস্য আলি শাহিনের একটি পোস্টের পর এ দাবি আরও জোরালো হয়। তবে সৌদি সংবাদমাধ্যম ওকাজ-কে দেওয়া সাক্ষাৎকারে কার্লোস বলেন, ‘ইসলামের প্রতি আমার সর্বোচ্চ শ্রদ্ধা রয়েছে। আমার স্ত্রীকে নামাজ পড়তে দেখা খুবই সুন্দর বিষয়। তবে আমার ইসলাম গ্রহণ নিয়ে যে গুজব ছড়িয়েছে, তা সত্য নয়।’ বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠান নিয়ে তিনি জানান, ‘পরিবারের ক্যাথলিক সদস্যদের বিশ্বাস এবং তার স্ত্রী ও মুসলিম বন্ধুদের বিশ্বাস, উভয়ের প্রতি সম্মান রেখেই আলাদাভাবে অনুষ্ঠান আয়োজন করা হয়েছিল। সূত্র: ওকাজের বরাতে দ্য গোল #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने वंदे मातरम् पर कांग्रेस के CWC प्रस्ताव पर कहा, "कल कांग्रेस पार्टी की कार्यसमिति ने एक आश्चर्यजनक और देशविरोधी फैसला लिया है। उन्होंने अपनी पार्टी के 1937 के प्रस्ताव को फॉलो करते हुए वंदे मातरम् गीत के 2 ही छंद गाने का फैसला किया है। मैं पूरे देश को याद दिलाना चाहता हूं कि 1937 में कांग्रेस पार्टी ने मुस्लिम तुष्टीकरण के लिए वंदे मातरम् के 2 टुकड़े करके देश के विभाजन की नींव डाली थी जिसके बाद 2 राष्ट्र के सिद्धांत को ताकत मिली थी। देश का विभाजन हुआ और पाकिस्तान का जन्म हुआ। जब उस ऐतिहासिक गलती को मोदी सरकार ने सुधारकर और पूरा गीत गाकर राष्ट्रीय एकात्मता को फिर एक बार सुदृढ़ करने का प्रयास किया है। हमने सभी सरकारी फंक्शन में इसे पूरा गाने के निर्णय को कानूनी जामा भी पहनाया है। इसकी अवहेलना का कांग्रेस ने निर्णय किया है। कांग्रेस का यह निर्णय इनकी घोर तुष्टीकरण की नीति की पुष्टि करता है। वोट बैंक के तुष्टीकरण के लिए इन्होंने स्वर्गीय बंकिम बाबू के अमर कृति का न केवल अपमान किया है बल्कि लाखों शहीदों का अपमान किया है जो देश की आजादी का नारा लगाते हुए फांसी पर चढ़ गए थे और जिन्होंने कई साल जेल में काटे थे। आज कांग्रेस पार्टी अपने 1937 के प्रस्ताव को तो मान रही है लेकिन संसद द्वारा बनाए गए कानून को नकार रही है। मुझे हैरानी है कि राहुल गांधी के नेतृत्व में कांग्रेस पार्टी एक बार फिर तुष्टिकरण की राजनीति को आगे बढ़ा रही है। देश पहले भी 'वंदे मातरम' को दो हिस्सों में बंटने देने की गलती कर चुका है और हमने इसके नतीजे भुगते हैं। अब देश को कांग्रेस पार्टी के इस फ़ैसले के ख़िलाफ़ एकजुट होना चाहिए और कहना चाहिए कि उनकी तुष्टिकरण की राजनीति अब नहीं चलेगी। भाजपा कांग्रेस पार्टी के इस फ़ैसले की निंदा करती है। #Congress #VandeMatram #Politics #AmitShah #BJP #ZeeNews @AmitShah

The six Pakistani sailors injured in the recent Houthi attack on a Tanzanian-flagged commercial vessel have safely returned to Pakistan, while the mortal remains of the two Pakistani sailors who tragically lost their lives have also been repatriated. All relevant stakeholders have been directed to ensure their safe, dignified and expeditious repatriation. I commend the Consulate General of Pakistan in Jeddah and our Embassy in Riyadh for their prompt and dedicated efforts in facilitating the return of the injured and repatriation of the bodies from Yemen and onward travel to Pakistan, in the absence of a Pakistani diplomatic mission in Yemen. I also appreciate the efforts of all relevant stakeholders, including the FIA, in facilitating their smooth arrival and onward arrangements in Pakistan. I deeply appreciate the cooperation extended by the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, including the medical assistance and arrangements provided in Jeddah. Pakistan condemns the attack in the strongest terms and reiterates that the safety and security of seafarers must be ensured at all times. We remain committed to extending all possible assistance to the injured sailors and the bereaved families.

উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গী পার্থিব জীবনকে আনন্দময় করে তুলে। উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গী পাওয়া প্রতিটি পুরুষের জীবনের অন্যতম চাওয়া। আধুনিক রঙিন এ সময়ে একজন উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গীই একজন পুরুষের ঈমান, আমল রক্ষার অন্যতম মাধ্যম। বিয়ের মাধ্যমে নারী-পুরুষের নিঃসঙ্গতা ও একাকিত্ব দূর হয়। হাদিসে বিয়েকে ঈমানের পূর্ণতা বলা হয়েছে। সৃষ্টিগতভাবেই নারী-পুরুষ একে অপরের পরিপূরক। নারী ছাড়া পুরুষ এবং পুরুষ ছাড়া নারীর জীবন অসম্পূর্ণ। মহান আল্লাহ হযরত আদম (আ.) কে সৃষ্টি করার পর হযরত হাওয়া (আ.) কে তার জীবন সাথি হিসেবে সৃষ্টি করেন। তাদের বিয়ের মাধ্যমে ভালোবাসার বন্ধনে আবদ্ধ করে দেন। সেই ধারাবাহিকতা এখনো পৃথিবীতে চলমান। উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গী লাভের দোয়া পবিত্র কুরআনে হযরত মুসা (আ.)-এর কাহিনী বর্ণিত হয়েছে। সেখানে হযরত মুসা (আ.)-এর একটি দোয়াও এসেছে। যে দোয়া পড়ার পর মহান আল্লাহ তার জন্য থাকা-খাওয়ার ব্যবস্থা করেছেন। তার আশ্রয়ের পাশাপাশি উত্তম জীবন সঙ্গিনীর ব্যবস্থাও করে দিয়েছেন। শিক্ষণীয় সেই দোয়াটি হলো- رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَیَّ مِنۡ خَیۡرٍ فَقِیۡرٌ উচ্চারণ: রব্বি ইন্নি লিমা আনযালতা ইলাইয়া মিন খাইরিন ফাকির। অর্থ: হে আমার রব, তুমি আমার প্রতি যে অনুগ্রহ পাঠাবে, আমি তার মুখাপেক্ষী। (সুরা আল-কাসাস, আয়াত : ২৪) মহান আল্লাহ চোখ শীতলকারী স্ত্রী ও সন্তানের জন্য পবিত্র কুরআনে বর্ণিত দোয়াটি শিখিয়ে দিয়েছেন। رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّۃَ اَعۡیُنٍ وَّ اجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِمَامًا উচ্চারণ: রব্বানা হাবলানা মিন আযওয়াজিনা ওয়া যুররিইয়্যাতিনা কুররতা আইয়ুনিও ওয়াজআলনা লিল মুত্তাকীনা ইমামা। অর্থ: হে আমাদের প্রতিপালক! আপনি আমাদের এমন স্ত্রী ও সন্তান দান করুন। যারা আমাদের চোখ জুড়িয়ে দেয় আর আমাদেরকে (পুরুষদেরকে) মুত্তাকি লোকদের নেতা বানিয়ে দিন। (সুরা ফোরকান, আয়াত : ৭৪)

In this episode of All Things Policy, Gopal Tomar speaks to Dr Dheeraj Dwarakanath about what it would take for India to build a sovereign AI ecosystem on its own terms. They look beyond the hardware to understand where India's real bottlenecks and strengths lie, from electricity, data centres and semiconductor manufacturing to talent, research, multilingual AI and digital public infrastructure. They also examine whether India should compete with the US and China on their terms, or instead build an AI system focused on scale, affordability, delivery and the needs of its billion-plus people. The Milky Way and the Altair and Vega stars on both sides are pictured in Jiamusi City of northeast China's Heilongjiang Province. Known as the Chinese version of the Valentine's Day💕, the Qixi Festival is celebrated on the seventh day of the seventh month on the Chinese lunar calendar. The stars Altair and Vega, regarded as Niu Lang and Zhi Nyu, were beloved couple in the legend who were separated to opposite sides of the Milky Way. Moved by their plight, magpies intervened, creating the bridge with their wings on the seventh night of the seventh month of China's lunar calendar, allowing the couple to reunite for just one day each year. (Source: Xinhua)

З ночі тривають роботи наших екстрених служб на місцях російських влучань. Масований був удар – росіяни довго готувалися і комбінували балістику різних типів, крилаті ракети й дрони так, щоб якомога сильніше пошкодити цивільну інфраструктуру. Є руйнування в Києві та області, на Одещині та Чернігівщині. У столиці пошкоджено житлові будинки, зокрема багатоповерхівку, де зруйнували верхні поверхи, також дитячу лікарню та школу. Аварійно-рятувальні роботи продовжуються. Станом на зараз відомо, що цей російський удар забрав життя 12 людей у Києві, є загибла людина в області. Співчуття всім рідним та близьким. Ще близько 40 людей поранені. На Одещині ворог атакував дронами пункт пропуску на кордоні з Молдовою, на Чернігівщині – газову інфраструктуру. Дякую всім рятувальникам, медикам, поліцейським і комунальникам, які з перших хвилин допомагають людям. На жаль, в той час як Москва вкладається у балістику та ескалацію, не завжди є потрібна реакція світу на такі удари. І поки в України буде недостатньо антибалістики, серйозно думати про мир Росія не буде. Ми робимо все, щоб захист був, і щодня йде робота над програмою FREYJA. Але перехоплювачі до «петріотів» поки що не замінити, і вони потрібні щодня. Кожна додаткова ракета зберігає життя наших людей. Я дякую всім, хто це розуміє, шукає і знаходить можливості допомогти.

Emergency crews have been working at the sites of Russian strikes since overnight. It was a massive attack – the Russians had been preparing for a long time, combining different types of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones, aiming to cause as much damage as possible to civilian infrastructure. There is destruction in Kyiv and the region, as well as in the Odesa and Chernihiv regions. In the capital, residential buildings were damaged, including a high-rise whose upper floors were destroyed, as well as a children’s hospital and a school. Emergency response and rescue operations are ongoing. As of now, we know that this Russian strike has claimed the lives of 12 people in Kyiv, with one person killed in the region. My condolences to all the families and loved ones. Around 40 more people were injured. In the Odesa region, the enemy carried out a drone attack on a border crossing with Moldova; in the Chernihiv region, it targeted gas infrastructure. I thank all the rescuers, medics, police officers, and utility workers who have been helping people from the first moments. Unfortunately, while Moscow is investing in ballistic missiles and escalation, such strikes do not always receive the response they should from the world. And as long as Ukraine does not have enough anti-ballistic defense, Russia will not consider peace seriously. We are doing everything to ensure we have that protection, and work on the FREYJA program continues every day. But Patriot interceptors cannot yet be replaced, and we need them every day. Every additional missile saves the lives of our people. I thank everyone who understands this and is looking for and finding ways to help.

Subsea cables are the fibre-optic networks laid across the ocean floor that carry approximately 95% of all intercontinental digital communications, serving as the essential, yet often invisible, backbone of the modern global internet. In India, the subsea cable ecosystem is constrained by regulatory gaps, procurement hurdles, and structural commercial barriers, resulting in significant vulnerabilities in the nation’s digital connectivity. In this episode of All Things Policy, Anisree Suresh (@AnisreeSuresh) and Anwesha Sen (@Anwxsha) explore these vulnerabilities and discuss ways to mitigate the same. This is despite the fact that coal based generators may be operating at their technical minimum, meaning going down any further will only damage the machines. Consequently, solar generators are being asked to back down, disturbing their economics. Dasgupta adds that had storage been available, the excess daytime power could be used to charge the batteries and also to pump water from the lower reservoir to the higher reservoir in pump storage plants. There seems to be no possibility of immediate relief since the completion of ongoing storage schemes is doubtful due to non-remunerative tariffs arrived at through competitive bidding. Try @Grok @Bot DJ (@congressdj) I am not a coder. I don’t work with CRM or play with spreadsheets. I’m about as removed from a “workflow” in my job as a kid flying a kite. I don’t really use AI beyond a super-Google level. So when I say Grok Bot is ABSOLUTELY GAME CHANGING, I don’t mean a better search tool. I mean it has fundamentally changed how I go about everything. And it did this in just a few hours. Let me explain. During the install, it asked if I wanted to connect it to several dozen programs. I don’t use a single one of them. So I thought, “Well, I’m not gonna get a lot of use out of this.” But I kept going. Then it asked if it could connect to my Gmail. I said yes. And that’s where the jaw-dropping began. It immediately figured out my life. It saw 40,000 emails and got a pretty good picture of me. So I asked it to do my taxes. It found all the docs needed in my email and did my taxes. I asked it to find first-class award tickets to Japan. It scoured the internet and logged into my airline accounts (with permission) and found 3 tickets to Japan in first class for 60K points. It would have booked them, but I’m still not sure of the dates I need so I stopped it. I created a few agents. One gives me an hourly political update based on key topics I need for work. One is cleaning up my Gmail inbox and organizing it. One is saving me money in my taxes. One makes sure it always checks with me on key decisions (like deleting an email). It’s absolutely insane. In this episode of the All Things Policy podcast, Kavya Rai and Abhishek Kadiyala (@AbhishekSocials) examine India's 2026 amendments to the Foreign Contribution Regulation Act and why a domestic funding law has drawn attention in Washington. The conversation frames the issue as a collision between Indian regulatory sovereignty and the rising force of religious-freedom politics in the United States. It traces the money at stake, from American donors to Indian recipients, and situates the debate within USCIRF hearings, Congressional interest, and the evangelical turn in US politics. The episode argues that while the executive has shown limited appetite for action, having moved only against Nigeria, the FCRA question retains real nuisance value as a Congressional and electoral lever. It ultimately asks whether this issue becomes an active irritant in India-US ties, or remains a low-grade friction ahead of the midterms. Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. OPENAI DEJA DE ENTRENAR NUEVOS MODELOS DE IA DEBIDO A LOS RIESGOS DE CIBERSEGURIDAD | Por Renzo Gonzales OpenAI ha decidido suspender el desarrollo de nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial tras detectar riesgos de ciberseguridad que superan sus sistemas de control actuales. En un comunicado oficial publicado en su blog, la empresa explicó que los modelos más avanzados representan desafíos de seguridad cada vez mayores. “A medida que los modelos ganan capacidad, los riesgos asociados a su desarrollo y prueba interna también crecen”, señaló la firma. La organización admitió que su próximo modelo, denominado Astra, podría alcanzar el umbral de “capacidades críticas de ciberseguridad”, una alerta interna que deriva en la suspensión temporal de los trabajos de investigación y entrenamiento. تا امروز بر هیچ‌کسی پوشیده نیست که پشت ۴۰ سال جنگی که به نام دین در افغانستان رخ داده، نزاع بر سر قدرت، هویت قومی و انحصار فرمانروایی قرار داشته است. گروه‌های مدعی حاکمیت، از خدا، دین، وطن، انقلاب و نجات مردم به‌عنوان شعارهای اصلی رفتارشان سود برده‌اند تا مرگ میلیونی مردم را از حادثه‌ای بیهوده به مأموریتی بزرگ الهی، جهت برپایی حاکمیت الله و رسیدن به حوران بهشتی، تبدیل کنند. قدرت عریان به‌تنهایی توانایی بسیج مردم برای مرگ را ندارد و همین‌جاست که دین، در گستره‌ی هستی انسان افغانستانی، در درون این چرخه‌ی منازعات، تنها به‌عنوان یک عقیده‌ی شخصی باقی نماند و به زبان قدرت و زور تبدیل شد؛ زوری که خود را به حق و حقیقت آسمانی پیوند می‌دهد، اطاعت بی‌چون‌وچرا را به فضیلت شرعی و جنگ را به وظیفه‌ای اجباری تفسیر می‌نماید. از آن‌جایی که تفنگ، ایجاد وحشت و کشتار برای دوام حکومت کافی نیست، تلاش حاکمیت‌ها و گروه‌های سیاسی ما این بوده است تا مردم فرمان او را با این احساس بپذیرند که اطاعتشان مطابق دستور شریعت الهی و اخلاقی است. هرچه دولت ضعیف‌تر، قانون بی‌اعتبارتر و نهادهای عمومی بی‌اعتمادتر باشند، قدرت بیشتر به چیزی بیرون از خود پناه می‌برد که در افغانستان، این پناهگاه اغلب اسلام و شریعت محمدی و گاه هم هژمون قبیله بوده است. از آغاز سال‌های ۱۷۴۷ تا امروز، مشروعیت سیاسی در افغانستان مدام آواره بوده و مکان ثابتی نداشته است. این مشروعیت بی‌خانمان، زمانی در سلطنت جست‌وجو شده، زمانی در گلیم وارداتی انقلاب کارگری، گاهی در گرایشات فرسوده‌ی قومی، در برهه‌هایی در وجود مفهوم بی‌بار جهاد و سرانجام در تابوت بی‌جنازه‌ی انتخابات و شاکله‌ی امارت. تاریخ ما گواه است که هیچ‌یک از این منابع نتوانسته‌اند بنای مشترک و مورد اعتماد همه را بیافرینند. در این دیار، دولت بارها و بارها فروریخته، قانون نداشته باشد، راه پیوند دادن آن به خدا و شریعت برای حاکم کوتاه‌تر می‌شود. مشکل تاریخی ما این است که دستگاه قدرت و حاکمیت همیشه از دین به‌عنوان ابزار تحکیم خود استفاده کرده و الگوی تاریخی حاکمیت این The Air Force has now placed Maj. Jason Watson in pretrial confinement following his public calls for President Donald J. Trump’s impeachment. Watson was previously arrested on July 1st after delivering a speech on the U.S. Capitol steps calling for the impeachment of President Trump while in uniform. He was not formally charged by the military over that demonstration, although wearing a uniform while participating in political activity is prohibited by military regulations. He was detained again on Aug. 18, one day after criticizing Trump in a CNN interview. According to his attorney, Watson had informed his chain of command that he would no longer wear his uniform and was arrested after refusing an order to put it back on. The Air Force says there is probable cause supporting allegations of “continued misconduct,” but Watson has not yet been formally charged. His attorney expects potential charges under Article 88, which prohibits contemptuous words against certain senior government officials, or Article 92 for failure to obey an order.
